candidates.decision_relevance: Reconstructing timestamp-aligned lead-lag order among price, ETH/BTC, breadth, funding, open interest, flow, depth and sentiment would materially distinguish transient pullbacks from persistent deterioration and reduce cross-horizon and hindsight ambiguity.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped multi-horizon sensor sequence with forecast-cutoff availability markers
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied captures contain isolated snapshots and mismatched or unavailable horizons; temporal order and ex-ante information boundaries cannot be audited.

candidates.decision_relevance: A stable, historically retained cross-sectional participation series would materially improve the unresolved distinction between narrow ETH rotation, broadening participation and distribution.
candidates.metric_name: Membership-stable broad-alt and large-cap breadth history
candidates.missing_history_problem: Available breadth is a changing-membership top-100 proxy, so persistence, universe representativeness and before/after deterioration cannot be established.

candidates.decision_relevance: Historical liquidation composition and complete derivatives participation records would materially clarify whether deleveraging reflected forced long selling, short covering, or a reset followed by recovery.
candidates.metric_name: Complete liquidation-side, open-interest, funding and recovery event history
candidates.missing_history_problem: Liquidations are lower-bound legacy captures with unverified completeness, while OI and funding changes lack positioning-side composition and post-event price/participation sequence.

candidates.decision_relevance: A settled daily ETF-flow history with within-session and asset-level detail would test whether reported demand persisted, translated into price support and offset breadth or liquidity deterioration.
candidates.metric_name: BTC/ETH settled ETF flow sequence with session-level composition
candidates.missing_history_problem: ETF evidence is stale or a single weekly total, with no comparable flow-change series, concentration, sequencing or price-response history.

candidates.decision_relevance: Historical stablecoin issuance, redemption, exchange balances and deployment/turnover observations would materially distinguish passive supply growth from liquidity transmission into market participation.
candidates.missing_history_problem: Only supply changes are available; the analyses explicitly note that supply growth does not establish deployment or risk appetite.

candidates.decision_relevance: Recovering frozen candidate specifications, issuance cutoffs and matured outcomes would materially enable audit of range containment, directional accuracy, hindsight leakage and calibration claims.
candidates.missing_history_problem: Weekly reviews report prior candidate counts but omit candidate definitions, freeze times, horizons, ranges, confidence and outcomes; exit-warning calibration has no matured rows.
